verdict.rationale: Isaac ROS lists teleoperation among its production-ready ROS packages. GR00T workflows describe capturing teleoperation demonstrations on a physical robot, and Isaac TeleOp is named as a data source. However, the evidence is thin and focused on capturing training data, not live operations. missing for 10: live video streaming to the operator, latency/responsiveness guarantees over real-world (WAN) networks, documented remote-ops workflow for an ops lead, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can teleoperate a remote robot with live video and responsive control over real-world networks

citations.quote: Deploy perception, localization, mapping, manipulation, teleoperation, and AI inference using production-ready ROS packages optimized for NVIDIA platforms.
